motion_system: The plate remains still. On activation, a brief narrow highlight follows the existing groove of the selected edge and stops at its break; geometry stays fixed. Reduced motion remains static.
color_drift: None over time; maintain powder-blue and lavender faces, localized lime rims, translucent blush passages and compact forest-green and navy accents.
glow_behavior: Only restrained surface glints along existing ridges; no halos, pulses or outlined targets.
